room.name: The Tide Keeps Time
room.hint: Every basin keeps its own tide. Drop to a float at low water and leave it before the thorns above; cross a thorn field only while the sea drowns it.

bank.author: Claude
bank.role: Landing Shores Core: every basin keeps its own tide
bank.solution: Ride each float on its rising sea and leave before the ceiling thorns; swim the drowned thorn fields at high water; change floats as two opposite tides pass.
bank.coreDescription: Every basin keeps its own sea. Leave on the tide, not after it.
bank.humanReview: Native whole route and all six fresh checkpoint sections verified. Awaiting player review.
